metric_description: Share of the period within the 1% error-rate ceiling; target 95% of windows compliant.
calculation_description: Current standard methodology for error-rate SLO attainment.

method_descriptions.all_errors: Every error counts toward the rate. Current standard.
method_descriptions.exclude_expected_failures: Excludes errors tagged 'expected' by the service.

team_incentive: Bonus pool released if the metric is at or above target at end of the current period
methodology_change_policy: Method change requires Architecture Review Board approval per SRE handbook Section 8.4
note: Metric is short of target this period.
